### 2026-10-12 – I started modeling the structure of my box, including rails for a sliding compartment similar to a drawer. I also mapped out the structure for 2 of the included board games (conveniently enough, this

**1.97h**

I started modeling the structure of my box, including rails for a sliding compartment similar to a drawer. I also mapped out the structure for 2 of the included board games (conveniently enough, this was chess and checkers so just a grid), and used linear pattern to speed that up.

### 2026-10-13 – again, continuing to try to merge the chessboard tiles together into one piece, got it to be 2 pieces, realise that theres an inherent non-manifold body, so that's the final one. I also made one of th

**1.63h**

again, continuing to try to merge the chessboard tiles together into one piece, got it to be 2 pieces, realise that theres an inherent non-manifold body, so that's the final one. I also made one of the first chess pieces, a King. it looks pretty decent as i did get inspo and tried to shape it similarly to a staunton piece, but i'll probably do the rest on my own.
